_note: Primary-mode readiness rubric. Mirrors ../readiness.json. Used by the primary scoring engine for all agents except Agent #8.

criteria.label: Functional correctness
criteria.description: Target passes its test suite and produces expected outputs.

criteria.label: Failure mode handling
criteria.description: Injected failures handled without data corruption or silent drops.

criteria.label: Performance under realistic load
criteria.description: p50 and p95 latency within SLA. Resource usage bounded.

criteria.label: Observability sufficient for ops
criteria.description: Metrics emitted to #10 Monitor. Errors structured.

criteria.label: Documentation present and accurate
criteria.description: Charter published. Inputs/outputs documented. Limitations listed.

criteria.label: Dependencies declared and healthy
criteria.description: Credentials + marketplace tools present and responding.
